fields.gap: Raising core Gc alone lowers Vc. Past Vc = 2 the CR-1457 branch sets gamma = kd (0.20) instead of 1, so the least SF falls (caps 0.510 CNT, 0.560 Be, 0.403 graphene at a 1e4 multiplier in my scan). The governing mode's own property is not a direction alone.
fields.direction: Any Gc direction must be paired with a knockdown direction, which has no sourced value above 0.20 today.
fields.effect: Gc is listed as not alone on all three P2 leaders.
